The hospital capacity risk calculation achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing all legacy pytest suites without exceptions.
The execution resulted in a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.85, with zero exceptions across all trials. The pytest tool (version 8.4.1) confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is stable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighted-risk formula to maintain the 1.00 mean reward.
